d:
Kabhi viran aur pathrili jamin ke rup men pahchane rakhne vale jharkhand jaguaar ka 200 ekar men phaila vishal parisar ab svachchh oorja ki naee misal banne ki disha men aage barh raha hai. yahan javanon ki bairak se lekar prashasnik bhavan, kaintin aur parisar ki sarkon tak roshni ke lie saur oorja ka istemal kiya ja raha hai.
